verdict.rationale: pnpm is a JavaScript package manager. It does not host or run user automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations falls outside its product category. Package versioning (`pnpm version -r`), dry-run installs and persistent patches concern packages and dependencies, not automations, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
